title: Describe a trade-off
question: How do you explain the App Service versus Container Apps trade-off?
observableCriteria: Each option is tied to the situation that makes it the better one, not to a general ranking
The configuration and cost that the second option adds are named as verifiable
modelAnswer: App Service reduces operational choices for a web application. Container Apps fits an existing container and revision needs, but adds configuration and cost to verify.
commonMistakes: Presenting one option as generally better without naming the situation it fits
variants: Changez une contrainte du scénario « Describe a trade-off » et expliquez si la décision reste valide.
